description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot global exception handler class 'GlobalExceptionHandler' which intercepts unhandled exceptions thrown in REST controllers and produces appropriate responses.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST controller advice class that handles all uncaught exceptions globally and logs the errors, returning a standardized negative response.

methods.name: handleException
methods.description: Handles all Throwable exceptions thrown during request processing, logs the error, and returns a NegativeResponse.

methods.name: handleDefault
methods.description: Generates a NegativeResponse with error details when an exception occurs.
